original_question: Steve decides to start eating more tomatoes and decides to grows his own cherry tomatoes.  He eats twice as much as his girlfriend.  He eats 6 per day.  If a vine can produce 3 tomatoes per week how many vines does he need?
question_template: {name_male, Steve} decides to start eating more tomatoes and decides to grow his own cherry tomatoes. He eats {num_text_1, twice} as much as his girlfriend. He eats {num_digit_1, 6} per day. If a vine can produce {num_digit_2, 3} tomatoes per week how many vines does he need?
question_solution: answer = (num_digit_1 * (1 + 1/f1) * 7) / num_digit_2  # f1 is the numeric value of num_text_1
